about_short_description.short_description: Zain Group is a mobile and data services operator in Middle East and Africa.

product.name: Mobile Voice and Data Services
product.description: Mobile telecommunications services providing voice calls, SMS, and cellular data connectivity to consumers and businesses across Zain’s operating markets.

product.name: Mobile Broadband
product.description: Wireless internet access delivered over Zain’s cellular networks for smartphones, tablets, routers, and other connected devices.

product.name: 5G Connectivity
product.description: Fifth-generation mobile network connectivity supporting higher data speeds, lower latency, and greater device capacity for consumer and enterprise applications.

product.name: Fixed Broadband and Home Internet
product.description: Residential and business internet access delivered through fixed or wireless access technologies, including broadband services using Zain’s network infrastructure.

product.name: Enterprise Connectivity
product.description: Connectivity and communications services for businesses and government organizations, including mobile, internet, dedicated network, and managed connectivity solutions.

product.name: ZainTECH Digital and ICT Solutions
product.description: Enterprise technology services covering cloud, cybersecurity, data centers, managed IT, digital transformation, and related information and communications technology needs.
